newsitem.title: UK: Armed pirates sieze gas oil vessel off Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Armed pirates sieze gas oil vessel off Singapore.

text.p: LONDON, Nov 22 -- A Malaysian-owned tanker carrying around 3,000 tonnes of gas oil has been hijacked east of Singapore with two crew members on board, an official at the International Maritime bureau of the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) said on Friday.
The Suci was hijacked on Tuesday by six armed pirates on Tuesday and is believed to have changed its name to Glory II, the official said.
Of the 17 crew, 15 were set adrift and were eventually rescued by a fishing boat. The remaining two crew are still believed to be on board the vessel.
The official appealed for any information about the vessel's current whereabouts.
